name: Buffalo Hunter

features.name: Stampede Super Bonus
features.description: Five scatters unlock the top bonus.

review:
A 5x4 prairie game where dreamcatcher mystery symbols all reveal the same symbol. Three or four scatters let you pick your bonus: Buffalo Horde turns premiums into buffalo, Prairie Multipliers add up to x5 to each premium, and both give +2 spins per upgrade.

Five scatters go straight to the Stampede Super Bonus. High volatility with a 12,647x max – and a 32% hit rate, so wins come fairly often for Nolimit. A fresh twist on the buffalo theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
